title: Aɣawas n usmel
lede: Akk isebtar ttwaferqen s usentel. Yal asebter yella s tefransist, s tanglizit akked taɛrabt.
xmlText: Tabdart tummidt n tensiwin, s tutlayin-nsent (hreflang). Tettwales-d i tikkelt mi ara d-yili usali amaynut.
llmsText: Agzul n usmel akked isebtar-is, s wammag llms.txt, i lmuteurat n tiririt akked imallalen.
meta: Aɣawas n usmel Qarṭaǧ : akk isebtar s usentel, s tefransist, tanglizit d taɛrabt.
